representative_scale.selection: All official PINDER-S cases with both primary apo monomers; one fixed cohort, no scale search.
representative_scale.reason: Fixed candidate count and repeat seeds must be preregistered; absent evidence retained as unavailable, not assigned a published value.

inputs.name: PINDER index and metadata
inputs.access: Exact URLs in inventory; filter pinder_s and both primary apo monomers.

inputs.name: Primary paired apo receptor and ligand for all 93 cases, native holo dimers, matching mapping files
inputs.access: Official individual pdbs/ and mappings/ URLs in inventory; use primary apo assignments from index.

inputs.name: Separated test structures
inputs.access: Official test_set_pdbs.zip and individual URLs in inventory.

inputs.name: FroDock software and bin/soap.bin
inputs.access: Use owner-authorized unverified mirror in inventory; bin/soap.bin SHA-256 791f31ec8ef1ef1466092b425638e926755519c9626f5678ca675ef6c76234fc. Do not substitute distinct src/frodockonstraint/Release_intel/soap.bin.

inputs.name: Separate AAV challenge coordinates
inputs.access: RCSB 6IHB.cif, 6JCQ.cif, 6JCS.cif, exact URLs and hashes in inventory.

outputs.poses: {results_dir}/frodock/{complex_id}/apo_decoys/model_{i}.pdb; full receptor-ligand complexes in predicted rank order
outputs.metrics: Per-pose DockQ, iRMSD, LRMSD and Fnat; per-case top-ranked and best-of-preregistered-candidate scores and success indicators.

timing_scope.end_to_end: Report input preparation, potential-grid construction, docking search, clustering/ranking, coordinate generation and scoring separately, plus complete elapsed run.
timing_scope.search: Docking stage wall time; retain MPI process count and hardware. Include grids in end-to-end; distinguish downloads/builds as setup.
timing_scope.time_to_acceptable: Elapsed time to first generated pose subsequently verified DockQ >=0.23; unavailable when implementation only exposes final batch, rather than inventing event timestamps.
timing_scope.cost: Use observed resource duration and actual price; no tariff supplied.

scoring_interface.scope: Directory of method/complex_id/apo_decoys/model_<rank>.pdb against official native structures.

rules.ranking: Report top-ranked pose separately from best DockQ among a fixed preregistered candidate count; retain failures in case accounting.
rules.candidate_count_reason: Brief requires a fixed number but supplies no number; inspected adapter requires n_solutions without a default. Must preregister before execution.
scientific_limits: AAV separated components support redocking only, not independently unbound docking.
Docking accuracy does not establish BBB transcytosis, binding affinity or therapeutic relevance.
Published-value checks cannot authenticate FroDock mirror against original study bytes.

scoring_interface.missing_system_policy: Do not silently drop missing or failed cases. Default evaluator validates completeness; report selected 93-case cohort explicitly.

budgets.reason: No timings measured; no estimates or overrides invented. Setup/anchors/profile inherit remaining ceiling when args budgets absent.
budgets.feasibility: Completion within budgets remains unknown before calibration; no builds/workloads authorized for intake.

unavailable_protocol_details.reason: Brief supplies no fixed candidate count, numerical seeds, repeat count or exact extraction specification. Must resolve before scientific execution.
